title: Failed to find a free participant index for domain 0: Cyclone DDS limits on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical, measured
excerpt: On one host, Cyclone DDS stopped at 9 ROS 2 processes on Humble over loopback and at 32 on Jazzy and Lyrical. Raising MaxAutoParticipantIndex worked on all three; ParticipantIndex none silently broke discovery with the localhost setting. Fast DDS ran 36-45 processes.
